info.title: AssistantHub REST API
info.description: AssistantHub is a platform for building and managing AI assistants with RAG capabilities. It provides endpoints for managing users, credentials, assistants, documents, ingestion rules, embedding/completion endpoints, and chat interactions.

BearerAuth.bearerFormat: Admin API key or bearer token
BearerAuth.description: Enter an AssistantHub admin API key or bearer token. Swagger sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

PassthroughObject.description: Pass-through JSON object returned by a subordinate service.

IndexRecord.description: Verbex index record. AssistantHub fills missing Name and CustomMetadata.ObjectName on create requests when possible.

SearchRequest.description: Verbex or RecallDB search request payload. Verbex index search supports opt-in enriched result fields.

Query.description: Search query text. Use * to browse Verbex index records.

MaxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

UseAndLogic.description: When true, all Verbex query terms must match.

IncludeMatchedTerms.description: Verbex index search only. Include MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeTermDetails.description: Verbex index search only. Include per-term score/frequency details and MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeDocumentTermStats.description: Verbex index search only. Include whole-document UniqueTermCount and TotalTermOccurrences.

SearchResponse.description: Verbex or RecallDB search response payload.

DocumentReindexRequest.description: Request body for document Verbex reindex operations.

DocumentIds.description: Optional explicit document identifiers to reindex.

IncludeAlreadyIndexed.description: When true, reindex documents even when Verbex metadata is already present.

DocumentReindexResult.description: Result for a single document Verbex reindex operation.

DocumentReindexBatchResult.description: Result for a batch document Verbex reindex operation.

AssistantDocumentSelectionItem.description: Safe public metadata for documents selectable in assistant chat.

role.description: Message role such as system, user, assistant, or tool.

thinking.description: Optional provider thinking/reasoning text. AssistantHub only emits this on assistant responses when the assistant setting ExposeThinking is enabled; clients should not send it back in request messages.

ChatMetadataFilter.description: Per-request metadata filter merged with assistant retrieval defaults.

stream.description: Ignored; streaming is controlled by assistant settings.

attached_document_ids.description: Optional AssistantDocument.Id values used to constrain RAG retrieval for this turn.

local_attachments.description: Optional user-uploaded files for this chat request only. Files are decoded or text-extracted for model context and are not added to the assistant collection.

ChatLocalAttachment.description: User-supplied file attachment for a single chat request.

base64_content.description: Base64 file content. Data URLs are accepted.

text.description: Already extracted text content. Use this instead of base64_content when the client has already extracted text.

ChatCompletionRetrieval.description: Retrieval telemetry included in assistant chat responses when RAG is active.

tool_calls.description: Optional safe metadata for model-directed server-side tool calls when assistant policy exposes user-visible tool traces.

ChatCompletionToolTrace.description: Safe chat-completion extension metadata for a model-directed assistant tool call.

provider_latency_ms.description: Provider-reported latency in milliseconds when available.

AssistantSettings.description: Assistant configuration settings. Includes model-directed server-side tool policy when configured.

ToolRoutingInferenceEndpointId.description: Optional completion endpoint ID used only for model tool-routing checks. Null falls back to InferenceEndpointId.

ExposeThinking.description: When true, provider-returned thinking/reasoning text may be included in assistant chat responses as message.thinking. Default false.

EnableAnswerabilityCheck.description: When true, run an LLM answerability check after retrieval and before final generation.

AnswerabilityInferenceEndpointId.description: Optional completion endpoint ID for answerability checks. Null falls back to InferenceEndpointId.

AnswerabilityPrompt.description: Optional answerability prompt template with {question} and {context} placeholders.

ToolPolicyJson.description: JSON-serialized AssistantToolPolicy. Null disables model-directed tool calls by default.

ExternalSearchConfigurationStatus.description: Safe external-search configuration status. Does not expose endpoints, API keys, or provider names.

Enabled.description: Whether external search is globally enabled.

AssistantToolPolicy.description: Administrator-controlled policy for server-side tools exposed to a model.

EnableDocumentAtomExtractionTool.description: Expose document_atom_extract for completed assistant documents and per-turn local chat attachments.

TavilyEndpoint.description: Assistant-level Tavily endpoint override. Null uses the system-wide provider.

TavilyApiKey.description: Assistant-level Tavily API key override. Null uses the system-wide provider.

MaxDocumentsConsideredPerSearch.description: Maximum assistant-visible documents a collection search may consider.

MaxResultsConsideredPerSearch.description: Maximum raw retrieval results collection_search may consider across all passes.

ReturnFullSearchContent.description: When false, collection_search returns excerpts and ContentOmitted=true instead of full chunk content.

AssistantToolCallRecord.description: Redacted persistent trace for one model-directed assistant tool call.

AssistantToolDescriptor.description: Effective server-side tool availability for an assistant.

AssistantToolPolicyValidationRequest.description: Request to validate an assistant tool policy without persisting it.

AssistantToolPolicyValidationResult.description: Result of validating an assistant tool policy.

AssistantToolPolicyTestResult.description: Result of an administrator dry-run diagnostic for assistant tool policy.
